about_the_game:
Real-time Online PvP(12 vs 12) and PvE Battles: Experience heart-pounding action in real-time battles against players from around the world. Engage in intense PvP and PvE battles in different game modes, bringing historical realism to Navy Field, the ultimate online action game.

Command Legendary Warships: Take control of over 500 warships from the USA, UK, Japan, Germany, Soviet Union, France, and Italy. Choose your favorite among cool destroyers, cruisers, battleships, aircraft carriers, and submarines. Strategically deploy your warships and aircraft to dominate your enemies from the skies, seas, and underwater.

Customize and Upgrade Your Fleet: Personalize your ships with various upgrades to enhance their performance in different scenarios. Choose your strategy wisely, whether it's using big guns, torpedoes, hedgehogs, fighters, dive bombers, torpedo bombers, mines, or airstrikes. Train your crew to optimize your ship's performance.

Historic Naval Battles of World War 2: Immerse yourself in realistic naval battles of World War 2 in Campaign Mode. Lead your fleet to victory across Europe and the Pacific Ocean, proving your skills.

Form Powerful Alliances: Join or create a clan and fight alongside your friends against enemies. Communicate in chat and cooperate with clan allies to dominate the ocean. In the epic Conquest World mode, seize resources and territories to make your Great Fleet.

Step aboard and become the ultimate naval commander!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 6th Gen or higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8th Gen or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
